notes.title: v25 now up and rocking!!
notes.content:
After MANY great comments from the amazing audience (and some phenomenal feedback) on NecroCaticGames' Twitch where we streamed the game, WE caught a few bugs and improved the game, I would say massively (one of the biggest updates to date). Here is a list of some (but not all) things we added:

-Grand Strokers now has it's own game category on Twitch!!

-Website to promote Grand Strokers now operational! Check out: https://www.grandstrokers.com/

-Statues now deteriorate when you inspect them.

-A ton of spots to inspect in the Town of Probable Destruction and maybe "something else" too!

-Chest in archives is fixed.

-Deleted the "Archives of Certain Enlightenment" off the world map. It's only access is the TOWN now.

-Gravestones at the starting point (TOWN) can now be inspected and used for upcoming pledges.

-Light Blue Splooge no longer drops better sword. Just the same as the other ones.

-Can no longer run in the Grand Stroker's Castle. WALKING only. "A mysterious force prevents you from walking in the castle." ... Damn should of added that.

-Sex Cyclops enemy added in Castle Stroker (see screenshot attached!)

-BGM fades properly when you get "SABOTAGED" so you can clearly hear the great sound alert by VaughnsEvilLair.

-Trouser Snake and Hardened Trouser Snake in the Tower of Imminent Peril will have a chance to poison now on attack.

-The Tower of Imminent Peril now has hatchlings that will spawn (in a certain webbed area) and a Mini Boss!! "The Spider Queen" has been added to the game!

-A text line appears when you say no when you are recruiting a character for your party. You are welcome, I knew you would appreciate it!

-A text line appears when you are in EVERY dungeon at the boss room. A face image appears of the boss and it says a line. Again, I worked hard on that part so...  PRETTY COOL!

-Wood will go to your inventory when you "interact" with it at the Poisonous Sperm Swamps of Ballachia. This will be used for a quest / crafting in a future patch.

-The piano chair in Grand Stroker's Castle prevented you from interacting with it. We fixed that!

-You could climb a lot of the places and glitch into the walls in certain spots both in the "Archives of Certain Enlightenment" and "Grand Stroker's Castle". I think all the spots were fixed and it's functioning properly!

And with that - that has been MOST of the updates / changes to the game. Thank you for reading this.

Please wishlist the game!


-NecroCatic Games-
